title: splitDiagrams
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Splits all diagrams into lazy loaded modules.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Mermaid will only load whichever diagram is being used.

comments.body: Minor typo. Change 'Remozing from detectors' to 'Removing from detectors'

comments.author: pbrolin47
comments.body:
It seems the majority of other diagram detectors have a declaration "const detector: DiagramDetector = ...",
but in this file the detector type is not present. It's only declared as "const detector = ..."

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags a missing type annotation on the detector declaration, implying it should be added to match convention.
